headline: Contested Sectors Keep the Base Ledger Moving
war_summary: Since the last edition, several unsettled fronts have added fresh entries, while the 34-town victory standard remains unmet and no victor is recorded. Weathered Expanse has climbed from 55 to 61 reported base events in 24 hours, with five in the latest two; its nine posts remain divided among five Colonial, two Warden and two neutral. Kuura Strand rose from 31 to 35 events, including four in the latest two hours, and remains split five Colonial to one Warden. Marban Hollow logged 34 events, six in the latest two hours, with four Warden-held posts, three Colonial-held and one neutral. Nevish Line reached 20 events, four recently, and stands five Warden to three Colonial. Stonecradle recorded six events, all at The Reach, and has one Warden post against eight Colonial. Linn Mercy’s 15 events were concentrated at Outwich Ranch, but its latest recorded shift was more than twelve hours ago; it holds nine Colonial posts, one Warden and one neutral. Many other maps show no base events in the past day. Casualty and enlistment figures measure regional activity, not current troop strength.
